//: kowloon-building controls that recreate the reference shop house bay by bay (the authored model="reference-corner"), from that model's own numbers. Edge 0 is the front, edge 1 the right side from the cut corner; storey 0 is the ground floor. The back and left edges are left to the seed.
/corner: The street corner is rounded with a radius of 0.55 m (four facets), and the green mosaic band runs through it. The front's wall ends 0.55 m before the corner (at 9.25 m) and the side's starts 0.55 m after it, so the front's wide bank and shop end at 8.75 m.
/facade: Thin string courses and no hood line; a tall parapet without a rail; green mosaic only under the wide right bank and round onto the side.
/shops: Front: a closed gate bay under a sagging green tarp on poles, then the open provisions shop under the striped canvas. Side: a gate and the open hardware shop.
/clutter: Crates and cartons stacked to the left of the front's gate and round the corner on the side street; the gates are galvanised.
/balcony: Per edge: from, to, depth, and where its fan-shaped divider stands. The door to it is in storey 1's wall.
/canopies: Corrugated hoods over these window banks (edge, storey, bank).
/services: Drain pipes at these distances along each edge; conduits as [x, z, rise, run, rise2].
